{{Top|leg}}
A '''Fusion WeldCut''' was a [[Fusion welder/Legends|fusion-welder]] capable of welding and cutting through [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hulls. It had oversized controls to allow the tool to be operated by individuals wearing [[Environment suit/Legends|space suits]].
